$meta.name: Dentino reminder-UI design tokens
$meta.method: Playwright MCP getComputedStyle extraction + in-browser WCAG-2.x contrast measurement
$meta.rule: extract-not-link (ADR-022): values re-implemented inline; brand colours contrast-adjusted to WCAG-AA; webfonts substituted with a Cyrillic-complete system stack

brand._accentNote: accent is DECORATIVE only on the confirm page (3.80:1 on white — fails AA text); use #C32847 (5.65:1) if an accent must carry legible text/icon meaning

text._mutedNote: darkened from the site's #8B8D8F (3.33:1 — fails AA) to #51606F (6.46:1 — passes)

action._cancelNote: Cancel is a navy OUTLINE secondary (navy text on white) — distinguished from the filled-navy Confirm by FILL + POSITION + LABEL, never colour alone (ADR-014/§5.2)
action._destructiveNote: #B3261E = 6.54:1 — used only for the interstitial's 'cancel without rescheduling' label/outline; the danger hue is a SUPPLEMENTARY cue, the explicit label is the primary one
action._successNote: #0F5132 text on white = 9.36:1 — post-confirm closure page accent

type.stack: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans", "Liberation Sans", sans-serif
type.substitutes: Gotham Pro / Gotham Pro Medium / Gotham Pro Bold (self-hosted .woff2 on dentino.com.ua)
type._note: site body is 12px on a desktop marketing scale; the confirm page deliberately resets to an 18px accessible base (constraint 7). Date/time is the largest element at 32px.

shadow._note: live site is flat (no box-shadows); a single very soft card shadow is the only addition, to lift the receipt card on low-end screens

contrastMeasured._note: WCAG-2.x ratios, measured in-browser 2026-06-18; each text pair MUST be >= 4.5:1. textOnBg=#14213A/#FFFFFF; mutedOnBg=#51606F/#FFFFFF; confirmOnBg=#FFFFFF/#0A3576; cancelOnBg=#0A3576/#FFFFFF; destructiveOnBg=#FFFFFF/#B3261E; successOnBg=#0F5132/#FFFFFF
